title: figure_ranking
description: What the figure critic returns (Implementation Decisions 13; research-notes 11 Section 4.1, step 4): every rendered draft ranked, with a score per rubric criterion and the reasons. A full ranking rather than a winner, so the pick can take another rank cheaply. Code checks that every draft is ranked once, that the ranks run 1 to n, and that no rank outscores the rank above it.

index_id.description: the draft's id, exactly as the prompt named it

rank.description: 1 is the draft that should become the figure

claim_legibility.description: does the shape say the claim before any label is read

honesty.description: does the draft assert nothing the data does not support

venue_fit.description: does it fit the venue and read like its comparables

legibility_at_size.description: data-ink and legibility at the target width and minimum font

reasons.description: why this rank, criterion by criterion, from what the PNG shows
